messages:
clara: Following the PG+KV timeout postmortem — let's lock remediation owners and add short runbook edits. Keep changes minimal and actionable.

pm_renee: listing what we need please (owners + ETA).

clara: propose:
- DB triage commands + thresholds -> tom (3 business days)
- Pager pre-checks + playback -> lina (2 business days)
- Scheduler throttling check -> infra (7 days)

tom: I'll add exact SQL/kubectl snippets and threshold guidance. PR ETA 72h.

lina: will add the pre-escalation DM step and a 5-10min playback script into the pager doc. PR ETA 48h.

infra: we'll run a 48h job start-time sample and validate throttle threshold; plan config change for limiter after validation. ETA 7 days.

sre_bot: Incident link auto-attached: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026/pg-kv-timeout-1763449000

clara: tom include both shell and kubectl variants. example snippets for runbook: `psql -c "select now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();"`, `kubectl exec -n infra svc/pg -- psql -c \"select now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();\"`. thresholds: >=20s mitigation, >=60s escalate.

tom: noted. i'll also add a small 'when to throttle' checklist for background jobs.

lina: pager playback checklist will include: 1) run quick checks 2) gather logs `kubectl logs -l app=pg --tail=200` 3) execute DM escalation flow.

clara: create GH issues and link them to the postmortem. owners add issue numbers here.

tom: ISSUE-1330 created -> PR #456 (draft).

lina: ISSUE-1331 created -> PR #457 (ready).

infra: ISSUE-1332 created for scheduler analysis -> findings ETA 7 days.

pm_renee: cadence: owners ping this thread every 3 business days until PRs merged. I'll mark postmortem followups once all issues are linked.

sre_bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 3 business days: 1764870034.

clara: thanks all. keep items scoped small so we can close the critical runbook/pager PRs within a week. If blocked, ping me.
